name: chemistry_fe_global_et_raw
hypothesis: The 37-group fe_anion specialist contributes avoidable small-route variance, while the cu_o expert supplies the observed high-Tc gain and the large other expert is well supported; falling fe_anion back to global raw ExtraTrees will improve A01 without sacrificing its positive-Tc guard.
falsification: Falsified if pooled OOF MAE is not below A01's 7.8365759376 K or positive-Tc MAE exceeds G01's 8.8321655079 K; degradation localized to high-Tc error would indicate useful fe_anion specialization despite its small group count.
